function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a Windows command (cmd.exe /c) on the user's computer and return its output and exit code. Runs non-interactively (no stdin) in the working folder unless cwd is given. Default timeout 120 s, max 1800. Prefer the file tools for reading and editing files.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file with line numbers. Default 200 lines from start_line (1-based).

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 text file (parent folders are created).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace an exact, unique old_text with new_text in a file. Use replace_all only when every occurrence should change.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete one file or an empty folder (never recursive).

function.name: move_file
function.description: Move or rename a file or folder. Fails if the destination exists.

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List a folder: names, types and sizes.

function.name: find_files
function.description: Find files by glob pattern (e.g. '*.pdf') recursively under path.

function.name: open_url
function.description: Open a URL or a local file with the default Windows program (ShellExecute).

function.name: clipboard_read
function.description: Read the current text in the clipboard (truncated to 20000 characters).

function.name: screenshot
function.description: Capture the whole screen to a BMP file and return its path. Use it to look at the user's screen; the current model cannot receive the picture itself, so combine it with list of windows information.

function.name: system_info
function.description: Basic information: Windows version, user, computer name, home folder, working folder and the available tools.

function.name: notify
function.description: Show a Windows notification (tray balloon) to the user.
